title: Clean the swearing out of the baked on-screen lines
why: His answer Q76 (2026-10-18): clean the swearing out of on-screen lines but keep the attitude. Three baked lines swore: "You cheap bastard.", "Shit is about to get real." and "This is some shit Claude came up with." They now read "You cheapskate.", "Things are about to get real." and "This is some wild idea Claude came up with."
now: Three on-screen lines lost their swearing and kept their attitude.

edits.replacement: Things are about to get real.
